commit.message:
Add purge orphan images script & workflow

Added a TypeScript script and CI workflow to remove unreferenced images from Azure Blob Storage.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+name: Purge Orphan Images
+
+on:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: "0 3 * * *"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+jobs:
+  purge:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Setup Node
+        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 20
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: npm install
+
+      - name: Run purge
+        run: npm run purge
+        env:
+          TURSO_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.TURSO_DATABASE_URL }}
+          TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN }}
+          AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING }}

commit.message:
Adjust spacing and use image_url for star photo

Increase vertical spacing for the star name tooltip on the index page (mt-2 -> mt-5) to improve layout. Fix star detail page to use row.image_url for the photo source (was row.photo_url).
